{{Quote|I thought the Empire gunned down the lot of you, over Delphon way.|Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 8">[[Star Wars (1977) 8|''Star Wars'' (1977) 8]]</ref>}}
'''Delphon''' was a planet in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], near the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]]. It was headquarters of the [[Black Hole Gang/Legends|Black Hole Gang]], which the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] attempted to wipe out. The planet was represented in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] by [[Ilov Maas]].

==Behind the scenes==
The map of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] in the ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' erroneously shows Delphon at map coordinates K-13, placing it in the Core Worlds near the Giju Run.
